title: CONOR SHANAHAN WINS IN JAPAN
caption:
Guest entry, first time in the CUSCO GR Corolla, and a win: Conor Shanahan beat Naoki Nakamura in the wet final of D1GP Round 10 at Tokyo Drift, Odaiba. Brother Jack raced the sister car. 🇮🇪🇯🇵

Source: D1 Grand Prix

Photo: @formulad
